item.title: nvidia falls after jensen huang returns as ceo
item.description: nvidia's board reinstated huang about 12 days after he resigned amid a personal scandal and export probes. shares jumped about 31% on the news, then fell over 7% on tuesday. doj and sec probes into alleged chip smuggling continue, and some us senators criticise the reinstatement. source

item.title: india: winter session of parliament still unscheduled
item.description: dates not announced; the session is likely to start in the first week of december, or the monsoon session may simply be continued. the expected main item is a constitutional amendment on delimitation and women's reservation that could raise the lok sabha from 543 to up to 850 seats. based on government sources, so it may change. source

item.title: openai and cisco release shirudo
item.description: an open-source tool that uses ebpf to block specific exploits on running linux systems while patches roll out. pre-release; needs a patched kernel and tpm 2.0. source

item.title: dread was hijacked
item.description: attackers took over its onion domain and keys. its admin said the main onion private key was accidentally included in a goBalance update; reports also mention a goBalance flaw that exposed other hidden services. details differ between sources. source
